[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Ghitter Mannes''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] during their war against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], one of the Republic worlds that was invaded by the Empire, Sergeant Mannes tasked a Republic spacer to defend the Republic headquarters from the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] around [[Bugtown]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mannes' first name was only listed in the filename for her conversation in the game's text files.
